newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 27.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL
-------- COMMENTS - Bunker prices stayed within Tuesday's range amid a stable cargo market, traders said on Wednesday.

Offers started off high but gradually eased over the day to meet buyers' levels, traders said. They said volumes were higher compared to Tuesday's as shipowners continued to cover their requirements at current competitive prices.
